async function isFree(i) { return true; }
async function sleep(ms) {}

// CASE js_multi_break expect=pass
async function b1(ids) {
  let found = -1;
  for (let i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    if (await isFree(ids[i])) {
      found = ids[i];
      break;
    }
  }
  return found;
}

// CASE js_multi_sleep_tail expect=pass
async function b2(ids) {
  for (let i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    if (await isFree(ids[i])) return;
    await sleep(100);
  }
}

// CASE js_empty_update_return expect=pass
async function b5(ids) {
  for (let i = ids.length; i--; ) {
    if (await isFree(ids[i])) return ids[i];
  }
  return -1;
}

// CASE js_multi_throw expect=pass
async function b7(ids) {
  for (let i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    if (!(await isFree(ids[i]))) throw new Error("busy");
  }
}
